title: Governance & Center of Excellence
description: Establish robust governance frameworks, Center of Excellence practices, and enterprise standards for PEGA implementations

content.introduction: Enterprise PEGA implementations require robust governance frameworks and Center of Excellence practices to ensure consistency, quality, and strategic alignment. This lesson covers comprehensive governance strategies including standards, compliance, risk management, and organizational excellence.

sections.title: Enterprise Governance Framework
sections.content: Design comprehensive governance frameworks that encompass architecture standards, development practices, quality assurance, and strategic alignment across the organization.

sections.title: Center of Excellence Practices
sections.content: Establish and manage Center of Excellence practices that drive organizational excellence, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement in PEGA implementations.

sections.title: Development Standards and Guidelines
sections.content: Implement comprehensive development standards and guidelines that ensure consistency, quality, and maintainability across all PEGA applications and projects.

sections.title: Enterprise Architecture Governance
sections.content: Manage enterprise architecture governance including technology standards, integration patterns, data governance, and strategic technology decisions.

sections.title: Compliance and Risk Management
sections.content: Implement comprehensive compliance and risk management frameworks that address regulatory requirements, security standards, and business continuity.

sections.title: Performance Measurement and Optimization
sections.content: Establish performance measurement frameworks and optimization strategies that ensure applications meet business objectives and user expectations.
